core.title: Core lightweight installer
core.description: Build the default lightweight installer and portable package. Runtime components stay optional and are not bundled.

runtime-packs.title: Runtime packs only
runtime-packs.description: Build selected optional runtime packs without rebuilding the desktop installer.

with-packs.title: Installer plus sidecar runtime packs
with-packs.description: Build the lightweight installer, then place selected runtime packs next to it under runtime-packs/ for optional offline install.

voice-debug.title: Offline voice debug package
voice-debug.description: Build the legacy voice-heavy directory package for internal debugging only. This is not the default public release.
